name: Closed Lost Deal Exclusion Workflow
description: Verify Opportunity -> Deal -> Closed Lost and check that Lost Deals NEVER appear in Won Deals

planSteps.description: Register user 'sprite_lost@example.com' for company 'Lost Deals Corp'
Navigate to /accounts and create account 'Lost Account Corp'
Navigate to /pipeline and create opportunity 'Cancelled Project Opp' for account 'Lost Account Corp' with amount 200000
Open Cancelled Project Opp detail page and click Convert to Deal button
Click Mark Lost button on the Deal Detail page
Verify Cancelled Project Opp DOES NOT appear in the Won Deals table
